original_context_note: Compared spec.full_target byte-for-byte with target-selection.json/full_target and read all problem.md:1–175, basis-proof.md:1–83, the complete basis-registry.json dependencies/replacements and proof-context.json, plus retained basis-evidence-000.txt. The target remains every natural n including 0, nonempty compact E⊆Euclidean ℝ^n, and the Euclidean product equality. H001 is exactly the approved nonemptiness (problem.md:16–23); H002 is exactly compactness (21–23). No proof conclusion became H and no extra restriction is hidden in n or E. D001 retains I=[0,1]. D002–D006 retain the unnormalized diameter-power cover convention, empty-member zero cost and native [0,∞]-valued dimension. D004 has the frozen header's three nested infima and nonempty-member supremum unchanged; its added δ-cover clarification ensures ediam bounds, never the spurious toReal(∞)=0 criterion. D007 explicitly specifies max distance. D008–D012 define the measure, indicator, integral, finite-rank and ball notation used. D013–D017 give the original Euclidean spaces, total coordinate map and both product subsets. All D are total typed definitions with acyclic dependencies and no proved guards; crucially D015 grants no invertibility, which R007/S001 actually proves. The original definition and the native formula are identified by R001, not by an unproved normalization assertion. The authorized replacements are retained: B001/B002 via M001–M005 and R001; B003 via M006/M007; B004 by R004; B005 by R005; B006/B007/B009 through M010–M016 in R003; B008 through the exact provisional E001 statement and its retained complete B008 type/proof. I probed and read the actual pinned signatures and relevant defining contexts for all sixteen retained M sources; the broader native EMetric and pseudo-EMetric contracts, Borel conditions, NNReal exponents, countability and a.e.-measurability conditions are fully preserved. E001 is the only registry E port; its complete closed adapter type, proof and statement are frozen in basis-registry.json/dependencies/7, and its underlying-map identity and continuous-linear-equivalence source were inspected in the pinned Mathlib (including probe M017 as source evidence only). It is a prepared basis adapter, not a missing literature theorem, class-4 assumption or imported class-3 claim. No primary-source deferral or warning is needed. The original grid bound, special n=0 upper proof, compactness-based finite-content paragraph and separate interval lower-cover argument are replaced exactly as authorized by the registry, not silently omitted from an unchanged original route. The required covering costs, slicing errors, limits and explicit metric comparison are retained in R002, R003, R006 and R007. All five class-3 dependencies B010–B014 are internal derivations (R001, R002, R003, R006, R007/R008); none is E. The AND graph has one producer per N/P, no cycle and every non-H node in P's closure. Both original H are present and directly used at R008 to instantiate the nonempty compact premise of N006; no original H is discarded. R006 notes that its auxiliary mathematics does not itself require compactness beyond retaining that premise. Structural validity is only machine bookkeeping; the following are actual same-author packet inspections, not independent Audit A or mathematical certification.
